_about: Link comments for advert clips and EOI posts. Phill posts clips by hand (so he can add Instagram/Facebook music); the hourly reply runs read this file and add the matching comment to any of our posts from the last 72 hours that doesn't already have a krakenexpeditions.com.au comment from us. Match a post by its caption starting with first_line (Instagram) or fb_first_line (Facebook, falls back to first_line) (ignore emoji/whitespace differences). Instagram allows ONE URL per comment, so each ig_comments entry is a separate comment. If no entry matches, use the rules.
